# Cyberpsychology: Journal of Psychosocial Research on Cyberspace

> Open-access peer-reviewed journal publishing empirical research on psychological and social aspects of internet and digital technology use.

Cyberpsychology is an indexed academic journal covering emerging topics in digital psychology, from cyberbullying and social media effects to AI applications in mental health. The journal welcomes submissions from researchers worldwide and maintains rigorous peer-review standards.

## Key Topics

- Cyberpsychology
- Open-access research
- Cyberbullying
- Social media
- Mental health
- Social comparison
- Anxiety
- Adolescent behavior
- Empathy
- ChatGPT
- Generative AI
- Online behavior
- Privacy concerns
- Internet trolling
- Psychological analysis

## Journal Overview

- [Cyberpsychology: Journal of Psychosocial Research on Cyberspace](https://cyberpsychology.eu): Homepage for peer-reviewed open-access journal on cyberpsychology research
- [About the Journal](https://cyberpsychology.eu/about): Journal information, editorial board, indexing in Web of Science and SCOPUS

## Author Resources

- [For authors](https://cyberpsychology.eu/about/submissions): Author guidelines, submission requirements, and peer-review process

## Research Articles: Online Behavior & Social Dynamics

- [Striving for accuracy attenuates the positive relationship between cyberbullying bystanders' dispositional empathy and tendencies to help victims](https://cyberpsychology.eu/article/view/40683): Research article on cyberbullying bystanders, empathy, and helping behavior
- [The role of social norms for online prosocial & antisocial behavior among adolescents in Singapore](https://cyberpsychology.eu/article/view/37092): Study on social norms' influence on adolescent prosocial and antisocial behavior
- [When sadists become internet trolls: The mechanism of aggressive humor and self-concept clarity](https://cyberpsychology.eu/article/view/35694): Research on internet trolling, sadism, and aggressive humor mechanisms

## Research Articles: Mental Health & Social Media

- [Caught in the daily scroll: How upward social comparison fuels daily anxiety during short video use among Chinese young adults](https://cyberpsychology.eu/article/view/40189): Study on social comparison, anxiety, and short video app use in China

## Research Articles: AI & Technology Psychology

- [Evaluating strengths, limitations, and future directions of ChatGPT in psychological analysis within case conceptualization: A qualitative analysis](https://cyberpsychology.eu/article/view/40142): Qualitative analysis of ChatGPT's applications and limitations in psychology
- [Decoding user disclosure intentions in generative AI: Exploring the influence of system attributes on trust and privacy concerns within the extended technology acceptance model](https://cyberpsychology.eu/article/view/40364): Research on user disclosure, trust, and privacy in generative AI systems
